create_Lfm2VlConfig: create an Lfm2VlConfig instance that extends HuggingFace Lfm2VlConfig with SGLang hybrid model properties
get_full_attention_layer_ids: get full_attention_layer_ids property to return indices of attention layers for KV cache
get_linear_layer_ids: get linear_layer_ids property to return indices of conv layers for conv state cache
get_mamba2_cache_params: get mamba2_cache_params property to return Mamba2CacheParams for HybridReqToTokenPool initialization
override_config_mapping: override CONFIG_MAPPING._extra_content to register Lfm2VlConfig as the lfm2_vl config class
